chunks: They replied: "We cannot choose you in the face of the clear testimony we have received, and over Him who created us. So do what you are determined to do. All that you would do will only be confined to our life on earth."
ai.seo_question: What was the response of Pharaoh's people to Moses' signs?
ai.summary: In this verse, Pharaoh's people assert their loyalty to the divine proofs and the Creator who fashioned them, challenging Moses to execute his decree. They dismiss his authority as limited to the temporal realm, highlighting a key Shia theological theme of distinguishing between worldly power and eternal truth. This response underscores the stubbornness of those who prioritize immediate sensory evidence over prophetic guidance.
